title: Design: Move To dropdown lists the active terms
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Due on Receipt is the default for new customers.
  • Make sure at least one customer is on COD.
  • Make sure Net 7 and Net 15 are active.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p2-04-pick-another-term.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the COD row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Click the "Move To" box.
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The row menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The "Move Customers from COD" window opens.

Step 3:

  • A list opens over the customer list: "Due on Receipt" first, highlighted light blue with blue text, then the other active terms in the page's order (Net 7, Net 15 …).
  • COD is not in the list and no row carries a "Default" pill (as in ct-p2-04-pick-another-term.png).

Step 4:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R7: “"Move To" offers every active term except the one being moved from, in the S1-R5 order. It is prefilled with the shop's default; while the default is selected, the hint "Prefilled with your default for new customers." shows below it. When the term being moved from is the default, "Move To" starts empty.”
  • S4-N3: “Inactive terms and Credit Hold are valid sources (Move Customers is how a shop empties a deactivated term). Inactive terms are never offered in "Move To".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "2 Move customers to another term" ("Pick another term"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p2-04-pick-another-term.png

The design's own words:

  • “Any active term can be picked. COD is not offered because the customers are already on it.”
